title: ChatGPT Ads passes $1B run rate in 200 days
summary: ChatGPT Ads has reached a $1 billion annualised revenue run rate in under 200 days, marking a significant commercial milestone for OpenAI's advertising platform. The company is now expanding self-service ad access through Ads Manager to new regions including India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa, with tens of thousands of advertisers already using the platform.
problem_solved: Provides businesses with a new AI-powered advertising platform to reach ChatGPT's massive user base.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the unprecedented speed of commercial adoption for AI-native advertising products and validates OpenAI's monetization strategy beyond subscription models.
